diagnosis.headline: The transaction ran out of gas: it was given 24,000 units and used all of them before it finished.
diagnosis.why: Gas is the fee budget a sender sets for a transaction. This one was given 24,000 units, the work needed more, so the network stopped it half-way and kept the fee for the work already done (24,000 of 24,000 used).
fix: Send it again with a higher gas limit: the call needs about 37,096 units now, so set at least 46,370 (a 25% margin).
In a wallet, use the automatic gas estimate instead of typing a limit.
evidence: replayed with eth_call at block 31560420 (the state the transaction started from), same sender, value, data and gas limit
replaying the call with the same gas limit at the block before fails with an out-of-gas error
